_catalog_note: Beastman tier - not in setting-lore §5.2; demographics from ax_domains_of_chaos.xml (catalog 5.3). Naming/totemic flavor only.
homeland: no fixed homeland (hunting-grounds, bone-cracker dens, carrion-fields)

branch.regression: cackling laughs + yips (insert laugh-syllables hya/hag, h -> hyena-laugh, vowels yip-high, suffix -yip/-hag/-hyak)
branch.nature: hyena-folk; manic hunters and scavengers; pack-killers
branch.model: Kazhur rotted into a hyena's cackle

_note: Beastman culture: GNOLLS, hyena-folk - Kazhur rotted into cackling laughs and yips (qatal 'kill' -> Qatak-hyag). Manic pack-hunters and carrion-eaters. ALWAYS CHAOTIC; totemic shamanism (race-totem the Laughing Pack / the Carrion-Hyena). Deity-morphs Gul- prefixed. Mechanically stripped (catalog 5.3).

phonology.palette: Gnoll (Kazhur, cackle-yip regression): inserted laugh-syllables (hya/hag), h -> hyena-laugh, vowels yip-high, suffixes -yip/-hag/-hyak; manic, barking, laughing.
phonology.phonotactics: CVC broken by laugh-syllables; rising manic intonation.

morphology.naming_marker: named by the kashhag amid laughter at a kill; a cackle-name.

title_ladder._note: Mapped to the ACKS 7 civ tiers (the shared system; not a perfect fit) by how many clanholds a leader rules - barony = chief of one clanhold (lowest governing leader), empire = the great horde-lord over hundreds. thrall/warrior are NOT governing roles (see non_governing_ranks).
title_ladder.government: clanhold / hunting-pack (mapped to the civ 7-tier ladder by clanholds ruled)

march.scope: war-chief of a frontier / raiding clanhold

empire.scope: the great horde-lord over hundreds of clanholds

religion._note: CHAOTIC, totemic. Race-totem the Laughing Pack / the Carrion-Hyena. The Kashhag cackles to the totem and the Gul-spirits over the carrion-field; foremost Gul-Raptu the Blood-Hunt (gnolls live to hunt and scavenge); the One and the sun demonized.
religion.shaman_rites: cackle-chants over the carrion-field and bone-cracker pit; the donning of the hyena-hide; laughter at the kill.

holy_symbol_motifs.Carrion-Hyena: a laughing hyena-skull over cracked bones

banks_patterns.war_bands: the cackle-named packs: 'the Laughing Pack', 'the Bone-crackers', 'the Flesh-renders of [chief]'
banks_patterns.lairs_dungeons: hunting-grounds, bone-cracker dens, carrion-fields: 'the Den of [pack]', 'the Carrion-field of [chief]', 'the Bone-pit of [name]'
